{{Quote|Jedi business, go back to your drinks.|Anakin Skywalker to Immi Danoo and other clubgoers|audio=Anakin-JediBusiness-AOTC.flac|<ref name="AOTC">{{Film|II}}</ref>}}
'''Immi Danoo''' was a stylish [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Coruscanti/Legends|from]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] who was friends with [[Nyrat Agira/Legends|Nyrat Agira]] and [[Rosha Vess]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], she was inside the [[Outlander Club/Legends|Outlander Club]] on Coruscant with her friends at the same time as [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] and [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell]]. Shortly after, she drank and talked with her friends at the club when Wesell went into the club to [[Plot to assassinate Senator Amidala/Legends|hide]] from the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]. The trio watched as Wesell was disarmed by Kenobi.

==Biography==
Immi Danoo was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] [[Coruscanti/Legends|to]]<ref name="DB" /> the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Complete Locations" /> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]<ref name="DB" /> who participated in<ref name="Rogues">{{InsiderCite|136|Rogues Gallery|Rogues Gallery: A Night at the Outlander Club}}</ref> her homeworld's<ref name="DB" /> party scene.<ref name="Rogues" /> She club-hopped with her friends [[Nyrat Agira/Legends|Nyrat Agira]] and [[Rosha Vess]],<ref name="SWI752">{{InsiderCite|75|Who's Who in the Outlander Club: It's Ladies' Night}}</ref> who were members<ref name="DB2">{{DB|character|nyratagira|Agira, Nyrat}}</ref><ref name="DB3">{{DB|character|roshavess|Vess, Rosha}}</ref> of the religious<ref name="CSWEZealots">{{CSWECite|III|369|Zealots of Psusan}}</ref> cult [[Zealots of Psusan/Legends|Zealots of Psusan]].<ref name="Kalyn Farnmir">{{DB|character|kalynfarnmir|Farnmir, Kalyn}}</ref> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="NEC Note">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|II}} to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. The scene from ''[[Jango Fett: Bounty Hunter]]'' in which [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] is in the [[Outlander Club/Legends|Outlander Club]] takes place immediately before the film, therefore meaning it must be set in that [[Standard year/Legends|year]].</ref> Danoo and her friends were inside the [[Outlander Club/Legends|Outlander Club]],<ref name="Jango Fett: Bounty Hunter">''[[Jango Fett: Bounty Hunter]]''</ref> a [[Nightclub/Legends|nightclub]] and [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] hall located in the [[Uscru Entertainment District/Legends|Uscru Entertainment District]] of Coruscant.<ref name="CSWE2">{{CSWECite|II|431|Outlander Club}}</ref> They visited at the same time as [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] and [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell]], two [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] who were preparing to assassinate [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]].<ref name="Jango Fett: Bounty Hunter" />

[[File:NyratsFriendGroup-AOTC.png|thumb|right|300px|Danoo (left) visited the Outlander Club with her friends Nyrat Agira and Rosha Vess.]]
During a [[Local day/Legends|night]]<ref name="AOTC" /> shortly after,<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|II}} to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> Danoo, who was an eligible bachelorette,<ref name="Ladies">{{SWArchive|url=episode-ii/explore/attack/2002/06/imageattack20020621.html|series=Image Attack|text=Ladies of the Outlander}}</ref> was once again in the club with her friends. The group drank and talked with another Human near the club's bar when two [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]&mdash;[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]&mdash;entered, [[Plot to assassinate Senator Amidala/Legends|searching]] for Zam Wesell after she failed to [[Death/Legends|kill]] Amidala.<ref name="AOTC" /> The trio's fleeting attention was drawn<ref name="Coruscant Glam">{{SWArchive|url=episode-ii/explore/attack/2002/10/imageattack20021025.html|series=Image Attack|text=Coruscant Glam}}</ref> by Kenobi as he cut off Wesell's [[Limb/Legends|arm]] when she attempted to ambush him, turning to stare as he did so. Skywalker told the clubgoers to go back to their drinks and the Jedi left with Wesell.<ref name="AOTC" /> Not long after, Agira left Danoo and Vess to accompany [[Unidentified weak-minded individual/Legends|another patron]] of the club.<ref name="Complete Locations">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> 

==Personality and traits==
Danoo was friends with Nyrat Agira and Rosha Vess.<ref name="SWI752" /> The bachelorette<ref name="Ladies" /> was stylish<ref name="DB" /> and ditzy,<ref name="SWI752" /> had [[Color/Legends|light]] skin, blonde [[Hair/Legends|hair]], and was tall.<ref name="DB" /> Danoo was considered beautiful<ref name="Coruscant Glam" /> and otherworldly.<ref name="Ladies" />

==Equipment==
On the night she visited the Outlander Club<ref name="AOTC" /> in 22 [['ABY-BBY' dating system/Legends|BBY]],<ref name="NEC Note 2">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|II}} to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> she had on an [[Eye/Legends|eye]]-catching but impractical outfit<ref name="SWI752" /> consisting of a purple [[Clothing/Legends|top]] with puffy sleeves, an ankle-length [[Cape/Legends|cape]], a white [[Belt/Legends|belt]], light purple shorts, and black heels.<ref name="Ladies" />

==Behind the scenes==
===Outlander extra===
{{Quote|Conceived by Dermot Power in concept art, Immi's ensemble of short shorts, puffy shoulders and an ankle-length cape reveals everything there is to reveal about the character.|Daniel Wallace|<ref name="SWI752" />}}
[[File:ImmiDanooConcept.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Concept art of Immi Danoo was done by Dermot Power.]]
Immi Danoo was created for the [[prequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']],<ref name="AOTC" /> which was released on [[May 16]], [[2002]].<ref name="Year">''[[Star Wars Year by Year: A Visual Chronicle]]''</ref> The character was created by artist [[Dermot Power]] in concept art.<ref name="SWI752" /> The Outlander Club scenes including Danoo, who was portrayed by an uncredited extra,<ref name="AOTC" /> were shot at [[Fox Studios, Sydney]] on [[July 17]], [[2000]].<ref name="Mythmaking">''[[Mythmaking: Behind the Scenes of Attack of the Clones]]''</ref> Danoo was first revealed<ref name="WebDoc">{{SW|url=/video/good-to-g-o|series=Making Episode II Webdocs|text=Part 10: Good to G.O.}}</ref> on [[February 26]], 2002<ref name="Archive">{{SWArchive|url=episode-ii/bts/me2/archive.html|text=''Making Episode II Webdocs'' archive}}</ref> with the release of the web documentary "[[Making Episode II Webdocs|Good to G.O.]]"<ref name="WebDoc" /> Danoo then first appeared in illustrations in both the young readers book ''[[Jango Fett: Bounty Hunter]]'', written by [[Eric Arnold]] and illustrated by [[Valerie Reckert]],<ref name="Jango Fett: Bounty Hunter" /> and in the film's [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones (junior novelization)|junior novelization]], written by [[Patricia C. Wrede]].<ref name="JN">[[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones (junior novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'' junior novelization]]</ref> Both released on [[April 23]], 2002<ref name="Amazon">{{SWArchive|url=eu/lit/young/news20020225.html|text=Book Preview: Episode II Children's Books}}</ref> with the images of her in the books being taken from the then upcoming film.<ref name="AOTC" />

In the [[April 6]], [[2004]],<ref name="SW.com">{{SWArchive|url=community/fanclub/mag/news20040315.html|text=The New Face of Evil}}</ref> article "[[Who's Who in the Outlander Club: It's Ladies' Night]]," published in the [[Star Wars Insider 75|seventy-fifth issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' magazine, author [[Daniel Wallace]] states that Danoo and her friends' looks suggest the trio are the intergalactic embodiment of the [[Wikipedia:Valley girl|Valley Girl stereotype]]. When writing about the character [[Daro Willits]], Wallace describes his outfit to be "every bit as pretentious as Immi Danoo's."<ref name="SWI752" />

===Repurposing===
[[File:Naat Reath captured.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Photos of Immi Danoo were repurposed for Naat Reath (pictured).]]
For the expansion pack to the [[Ensemble Studios]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'', ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Clone Campaigns]]'',<ref name="Clone Campaigns">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Clone Campaigns]]''</ref> photos of Danoo and the character [[Dyemma Reel]]<ref name="Ladies" /> were used to create the character [[Naat Reath]].<ref name="Clone Campaigns" /> The expansion pack released on [[May 15]], 2002.<ref name="Clone Campaigns IGN">{{WebCite|url=https://www.ign.com/games/star-wars-galactic-battlegrounds-the-clone-campaigns|text=Star Wars Galactic Battlegrounds: The Clone Campaigns|work=[[Wikipedia:IGN|IGN]]|archivedate=20230516140746}}</ref>

Concept art of Danoo was erroneously used in the "Behind the Scenes" section in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Databank (original)|Databank]] entry for Nyrat Agira,<ref name="DB Agira">{{DB|character|nyratagira|Agira, Nyrat}}</ref> published on [[June 14]], 2002.<ref name="Coruscant Nightlife">{{SWArchive|url=databank/news/2002/06/news20020614.html|text=Coruscant Nightlife}}</ref> The character was then first given a name on [[October 25]], 2002, through the [[Image Attack]] feature on StarWars.com.<ref name="Coruscant Glam" />

Pictures of Outlander from Episode II that featured Danoo<ref name="AOTC" /> were used in the background of the webcomic ''[[Rookies: Rendezvous|Rookies: Rendezous]]'', written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]]<ref name="rookies">''[[Rookies: Rendezvous]]''</ref> and published from [[February 6|Feburary 6]], [[2006]],<ref name="WeekOne">{{Blog|pablog|47|Rookies: Rendezvous -- Week One Annotations}}</ref> to [[May 10]], 2006.<ref name="Week13">{{Blog|pablog|70|Rookies: Rendezvous -- Week Thirteen Annotations -- Finale}}</ref> As the pictures are repurposed and represent a gambling establishment on<ref name="rookies" /> the planet<ref name="ff">{{FactFile|116|ORD 1-2|Ord Mantell}}</ref> [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]]<ref name="rookies" /> around the year [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="rookiesdate">{{Blog|pablog|50|Rookies: Rendezvous -- Week Three Annotations}} states that ''[[Rookies: Rendezvous]]'' is set around the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], which is set in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] by ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> this article assumes the pictures do not constitute an appearance of Danoo.
